name: Average Joe
description: Blue-collar plumber, Joe Washington, discovers his recently deceased father lived a secret, second life and stole millions of dollars from dangerous people just before he died. Now those people think Joe knows where it is. A bloody and violent confrontation triggers a chain of events that force Joe and his close-knit circle of family and friends out of their very average and mundane lives into a life-or-death race against time to find the truth and the millions.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Joe discovers his recently deceased father was in cahoots with the Russian mob but broke his allegiance by stealing $10 million and a Lamborghini from them.

videos.title: Bachelor in Paradise
videos.overview: Joe, Leon, Cathy and Touch dispose of the dead Russians’ bodies, then another mob henchman comes looking for them.

videos.title: Donuts & Whiskey?
videos.overview: A special agent is called in after Dimitri's remains surface, Nicolai vows vengeance after learning of his son's death, and Joe finds a clue that may lead to the money's location.

videos.title: The Above Average School Teacher
videos.overview: Nicolai hires Arina, an ex-assassin, to find the man who killed his son (and bring him in alive), while Joe, Touch and Leon go on a mission to recover security footage before the police discover it.

videos.title: A Cautionary Tale of Frontier Justice
videos.overview: Joe hides the gang at a job site after escaping Arina, who has tracked down his address, and Pam wants to use Jennifer as bait to draw out Nicolai, but is shut down by Joe and Angela.

videos.title: Green and Blue
videos.overview: Cathy and Touch stage a distraction to draw the cops away from Joe’s house so Joe can sneak in and search for the money.

videos.title: Prisoners
videos.overview: Pam dangles drugs in front of a chained up and quickly deteriorating Touch to get more information about Joe and Nicolai. Touch confesses to covering up his negligence that led to Donna shooting her mother years ago.

videos.title: Ride or Die
videos.overview: Angela is rushed to the hospital, Nicolai seeks proof of Jenn’s claim, Pam appeals to her mom for help, and Cathy’s redoubled efforts to find the missing money yields unexpected results.

videos.title: Sounds Like Mail Man
videos.overview: Joe and Leon search Nicolai's cabin in an attempt to find Jennifer, and Cathy explores a potential side hustle.

videos.title: You Must Be Joe
videos.overview: As Touch and Pam race to Nicolai's cabin, Jennifer attempts to recruit Arina to their side to save Leon, and Joe battles Nicolai with everything he's got.
